news.headline: Sources: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn out indefinitely with torn quad
news.detail: Panthers cornerback Jaycee Horn will seek a second opinion on his torn quad, sources told NFL Network, but he is headed for injured reserve and could miss the rest of the 2026 season.
